description: This file defines the absl::variant type, a type-safe union similar to std::variant, including its interface, utility functions, and related operators. It provides mechanisms for managing variants, such as construction, assignment, visitation, and comparison.

classes.name: absl::variant
classes.description: A template class implementing a type-safe union for multiple types, with constructors, assignment, visitation, and comparison operators.

classes.name: absl::monostate
classes.description: A trivial class used as a default alternative type for variants.

methods.name: variant_size
methods.description: Returns the number of alternative types in a variant.

methods.name: variant_alternative
methods.description: Provides the type of the alternative at a given index.

methods.name: holds_alternative
methods.description: Checks if a variant currently holds a specific type.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a reference to the value stored in the variant by type or index.

methods.name: get_if
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the value if it is of the specified type or index, otherwise nullptr.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Applies a visitor function to the variant(s).

methods.name: valueless_by_exception
methods.description: Checks if the variant is in a valueless state due to an exception.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Returns the index of the currently held alternative.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Constructs a new value in-place within the variant.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the contents of two variants.
